svg.title: Build → test → image → compose up → health gates — **what actually exists, and what does not**

g.text: Build → test → image → compose up → health gates —
what actually exists, and what does not
there is no CI of any kind
. Every green step below is a human typing a command.
no `Makefile`, no `pytest.ini`/`pyproject.toml`, no pre-commit config, no coverage tooling · git history = 1 commit `87b0643`)
developer edits code on the DGX Spark host
repo is a single commit `87b0643 first commit`
no push / PR / tag hook exists anywhere.
`next lint` exists as an npm script (frontend/package.json)
but nothing invokes it; orchestrator has
(`.ruff_cache` is gitignored at `.gitignore:60` — the tool is not installed)
(frontend/README.md:39); no mypy for Python (`.mypy_cache` ignored, tool absent)
no Dependabot, no `pip-audit`, no `npm audit` gate,
no SBOM, no container image scan
3 · TEST — three separate commands, typed by hand
`docker compose run` with tests bind-mounted back in
3 of the 8 critical flows have no end-to-end test at all:
model returns a benign SELECT; a hostile one is never driven through)
«MISSING» no image build, no registry push, no artefact publish
nothing is versioned, signed, scanned or promoted
No `USER` directive and no `HEALTHCHECK` in orchestrator/Dockerfile;
base tag `nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm:26.05-py3` is mutable and undigested
5 · RUNTIME HEALTH GATES — the only automated gates that exist
compose blocks — this is the ONLY
automated gate in the entire delivery path
before the backend can answer a single request

THE SUITES ARE GOOD; THE PIPELINE IS ABSENT.

itself; `test_chart_pipeline.py:197-199` is `assert x is None or True`;
6 files assert on source strings, not behaviour

present. Behaviour-preserving refactors break them; behaviour changes
that keep the literal do not.

different Python minor than the containers actually ship.
REPRODUCIBILITY GAP — three different pinning regimes in one repo.
No `==`, no upper bound, no lockfile anywhere in the repo.
Two builds a week apart install different majors, with nothing to diff.
`torch` is deliberately unpinned and inherited from the base image
(`requirements.txt:2`), so the image is buildable on that base only.
`lancedb>=0.8,<1`). Still no hash lock, but bounded.
because a newer nightly "can silently break model loading" — i.e. the
deployment is reproducible only by never re-pulling.

because this machine happens to have it installed.
— gate is weaker than it looks
— dashed red border, does not exist at all
1 141 passing, 0 failing, every one of them unit-level.
8 «MISSING» stages: CI trigger · lint · type-check · dependency/CVE
scan · coverage · integration/E2E · image build · artefact publish.
